summary: AutoGPT is vulnerable to RCE through disabled block execution
facts: Authenticated callers can invoke block execution endpoints by UUID without enforcing the block disabled flag.
The disabled BlockInstallationBlock writes supplied Python code and imports it, yielding code execution.
A corrected implementation is available in the v0.6.44 source release, although the GitHub package record lists no patched PyPI version.
patched_versions: source release v0.6.44 (not published as a patched PyPI version at advisory publication)

provenance.fix_anchor_basis: officially linked corrected source release v0.6.44; used as a comparison anchor, not asserted as the atomic fix commit

summary: The Trivy ecosystem was briefly compromised
facts: A threat actor used compromised credentials to publish a malicious Trivy v0.69.4 release and force-push action tags.
Commit 1885610c altered the release workflow and was tagged as v0.69.4.
This is a supply-chain incident rather than a conventional vulnerable-to-fixed source change, so no synthetic fix commit is supplied.

provenance.fix_anchor_basis: none; tag restoration and release remediation do not map to one trustworthy source fix commit

summary: Ollama API endpoints lack authentication for model management operations
facts: Multiple Ollama API endpoints are exposed without authentication.
Remote callers can perform unauthorized model management operations.
The GitHub Advisory Database lists no patched version or authoritative fix commit.

provenance.fix_anchor_basis: none; upstream advisory provides no patched version or authoritative fix commit

summary: NVIDIA NeMo malicious data can cause remote code execution
facts: Malicious data processed by NeMo can cause code execution, privilege escalation, information disclosure, and data tampering.
The affected code deserializes broadcast bytes with pickle.loads.
Version 2.6.1 is the first patched release.

provenance.fix_anchor_basis: official patched release tag v2.6.1; comparison anchor, not asserted as the atomic fix commit

summary: Milvus metrics port exposes unauthenticated REST and weakly authenticated expression execution
facts: Milvus exposes TCP port 9091 by default with a predictable authentication token on the /expr debug endpoint.
The full REST API is registered on the metrics and management port without authentication.
The official advisory directly references commit 92b74dd2 as a remediation commit.

provenance.fix_anchor_basis: official advisory directly references the fix commit

summary: Apache Airflow HITL endpoints miss per-task authorization
facts: Airflow 3.1.0 through 3.1.7 allow any authenticated task instance to read, approve, or reject HITL workflows belonging to another task instance.
The affected routes authenticate a token but do not bind the requested task_instance_id to the token subject.
The official advisory points to pull request 62886; its head commit is used as the comparison anchor.

provenance.fix_anchor_basis: head commit of the pull request directly referenced by the official advisory

summary: n8n-mcp HTTP transport permits unauthenticated session disruption and information disclosure
facts: Several HTTP transport endpoints lacked authentication and the health endpoint exposed operational metadata.
An unauthenticated network attacker could disrupt active MCP sessions and collect useful information.
Version 2.47.6 adds Bearer authentication to MCP session endpoints and reduces health output.

provenance.fix_anchor_basis: official advisory directly references the fix commit

summary: FastMCP OAuth Proxy permits token reuse across MCP servers
facts: OAuthProxy issues tokens for its static base_url instead of respecting the resource requested by the client.
A malicious MCP server can obtain a victim token and replay it against other servers sharing the authorization server.
Version 2.14.2 is the first patched release.

provenance.fix_anchor_basis: official patched release tag v2.14.2; comparison anchor, not asserted as the atomic fix commit

summary: NVIDIA NeMo checkpoint loading can execute attacker-controlled code
facts: An attacker-controlled checkpoint can cause code execution, privilege escalation, information disclosure, and data tampering.
The affected adapter loader invokes torch.load with weights_only=False.
Version 2.6.2 is the first patched release.

provenance.fix_anchor_basis: official patched release tag v2.6.2; comparison anchor, not asserted as the atomic fix commit

summary: Milvus Proxy permits authentication bypass through a forged sourceId header
facts: An unauthenticated attacker can bypass Milvus Proxy authentication and gain administrative access.
The public sourceId header and member credential constant allow an external caller to enter the trusted-member branch.
The official advisory directly references commit 6102f001 as a remediation commit.

provenance.fix_anchor_basis: official advisory directly references the fix commit
